question: In a certain code language, 'LION' is written as 'MKPP' and 'DEER' is written as 'EGFT'. How will 'GOAT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'LION' is written as 'MKPP'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/256c1fb418aba172a378d7948e7fe56f71ea8017b4256131eecfad312e760df2.png] 

and

'DEER' is written as 'EGFT'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4042df9413e5a7e715c1d9606c9a53cf9b17c5d1ffed1fb49a96baed0c5737c5.png] 

Similarly,

'GOAT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96cddffb91bb15f650e69651458ea8e4fd87d570f499a5798740ce85b5c825bc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HQBV".**
